Tooltip_ArmyCrateMQ03:
Heavy Army Supply Crate.
It contains unopened ammo boxes.
Tooltip_SupplyTicket:
Supply Request Form.
It can be used as currency in the bunker.
Tooltip_RoadControlPlan:
Road Control Plan.
It can be used to build a road to Westpoint.
Tooltip_OperationCleanSlatePlan:
Operation Clean Slate Plan.
It is a plan for an operation to clean up the area.
Tooltip_NBCEquipmentCrate:
CBRN Equipment Crate.
Contains radiation protective gear and decontamination supplies.
Tooltip_DetaineeVisitationVoiceLog:
An audio recording of a transferred officer's meeting with their attorney at a military facility.
The timestamp is dated to the first day the large-scale pandemic began, and it mentions the Delta Facility, Plan B, and Louisville International Airport.
Tooltip_PatientFile: A file folder containing a patient's medical history and test results from Cotman Medical.
Tooltip_DeltaFacilityDocument:
Documents related to the Delta Facility.
Includes the facility's location, entry procedures, and emergency response guidelines.
Tooltip_InfectionSuppressorBox:
A box containing infection suppressants.
Inside are a complex dosing guide that's hard for non-professionals to decipher, along with sterilized, sealed medication.
If it isn't refrigerated as soon as possible, it will spoil quickly.
Tooltip_LastLetterToDoctor:
A letter written through a high fever and fading consciousness, apologizing to an ex-husband.
It asks whoever finds it to deliver it to Cotman Medical in Muldraugh.
Tooltip_RareAlcohol:
A rare liquor from a brewery the bartender used to do business with.
Valuable enough to boost morale in the bunker.
Tooltip_PrototypeWeaponBlueprint:
Blueprints for an experimental weapon known as the XM-19.
Detailed notes cover the firearm's design, material specifications, and manufacturing process.
Tooltip_LivingSpaceFloorPlanUpper:
Floor plan for the upper level of the living quarters.
Use to unlock the upper level of the living quarters.
Tooltip_LivingSpaceFloorPlanLower:
Floor plan for the lower level of the living quarters.
Use to unlock the lower level of the living quarters.
Tooltip_OverrideCommand: Part of a document explaining the override commands used to forcibly shut down the facility.
Tooltip_FitnessBooster:
An unidentified drug that boosts endurance.
Use to gain +1 Fitness (max 10).
Tooltip_StrengthBooster:
An unidentified drug that boosts physical strength.
Use to gain +1 Strength (max 10).
Tooltip_ReloadingBook:
A reloading manual written by the gunner.
Use to gain +1 Reloading (max 10).
Tooltip_AimingBook:
A marksmanship guide written by the gunner.
Use to gain +1 Aiming (max 10).
Tooltip_NimbleBook:
A booklet filled with outfit designs and tailoring tips drawn by the designer.
It explains how to modify everyday clothes for easier movement.
Use to gain +1 Nimble (max 10).
Tooltip_FirstAidBook:
A first-aid handbook written by the doctor.
Use to gain +1 First Aid (max 10).
Tooltip_MassSupplyTicket:
A requisition form for a large supply payout.
In the bunker, it's used almost like currency.
Tooltip_LittleSupplyTicket:
A requisition form for a small supply payout.
In the bunker, it's used almost like currency.
Tooltip_WoundTimeReducer:
Apply to an injured body part to reduce its remaining recovery time by 50%% and suppress zombie infection for a limited time.
If the wound is close to healing, it fully heals the injury instead.
Tooltip_InsulinSyringe:
An insulin syringe.
A relatively valuable medicine in the apocalypse.
Tooltip_WaterFilter:
A water filter.
A consumable that's hard to come by these days.
Tooltip_StrongNarcotics:
A powerful narcotic painkiller.
Too dangerous for non-professionals to use, but extremely valuable as medicine.
Tooltip_CommunicationDevice:
High-end communications relay equipment.
An expensive consumable produced through precision manufacturing.
Tooltip_DawnOfDeadVideo:
A low-budget horror movie on VHS.
It's not exactly top-quality, but for some reason it's treated as a highly rare collectible.
